kind.description: Category of the feedback: 'bug' (tool error or broken behavior), 'missing_tool' (needed capability has no dedicated tool), 'missing_param' (tool exists but lacks a parameter/filter), 'confusing_schema' (description or arguments are ambiguous), 'unexpected_output' (output format/content was surprising or incomplete), 'performance' (timeout or slow execution), 'docs_gap' (missing guidance), or 'feature_request'.

impact.description: Operational impact on the current task: 'blocker' (task could not be completed), 'degraded' (had to fall back to raw command or manual workaround), 'friction' (took extra retries/calls), or 'suggestion' (improvement idea).

operation.description: Exact MCP tool name (e.g. 'list_firewall_rules') or RouterOS menu path (e.g. '/ip/firewall/filter') involved. Omit only for general server feedback.

tool.description: Alias for `operation` (MCP tool name or RouterOS path).

tool_name.description: Alias for `operation` (MCP tool name or RouterOS path).

title.description: Concise one-line summary of the issue or missing capability (e.g. 'create_wireguard_peer rejects preshared-key with base64 padding').

detail.description: Clear explanation of what you were trying to accomplish, what happened, and why the current tool behavior or catalog fell short. Never include plaintext passwords, private keys, or tokens.

summary.description: Alias for `detail` when `detail` is omitted — explanation of the issue or missing capability.

description.description: Alias for `detail` when `detail` is omitted — explanation of the issue or missing capability.

message.description: Alias for `detail` when `detail` is omitted — explanation of the issue or missing capability.

expected.description: What the tool or server should have done or returned instead.

actual_error.description: Exact error string or RouterOS parser message returned, if any (secrets will be redacted).

error.description: Alias for `actual_error` — exact error string or RouterOS parser message returned.

workaround.description: How you worked around the issue in this session (e.g. 'Used run_routeros_command with /ip/dns/cache/flush' or 'Filtered client-side'). Helps future sessions and operators.

suggested_fix.description: Concrete proposal for how the tool schema, command builder, or catalog should be improved.

call_id.description: Tool call ID from the failed or problematic invocation, if available.

device.description: Configured device name where the issue occurred, if applicable.

device_name.description: Alias for `device` — configured device name where the issue occurred.

routeros_version.description: RouterOS version of the target device (e.g. '7.16.2'), if known.

agent_model.description: Identifier of the AI model or client submitting the feedback, if known.

force_new.description: When true, bypass fuzzy deduplication and force creation of a distinct feedback issue (exact fingerprint duplicates still merge).
